source.title: Belfast and Ulster Directory 1950, p. 44a (Belfast and Castlereagh Rural District Councils, Belfast Rural District Council)
source.publisher: Belfast and Ulster Directory (Belfast News-Letter); copy at Belfast Central Library
source.check: photo read: the Belfast Rural District Council member list, 9 names, no divisions printed

note: Triennial election of the nine electoral divisions of Belfast rural district, one member each. There was no contest in the district in 1949. The Belfast and Ulster Directory 1950 (compiled after the election) lists the nine members of the council without divisions; Wilson Cupples (Ballysillan) is on file from the News-Letter, and the other eight are placed in the eight remaining divisions. The directory prints T. M. Erskine among the nine members of the council without divisions; the division is inferred from the division the member held in the neighbouring rounds (T. S. Erskine held Ballygolan in 1946 and Thomas Morley Erskine in 1952). Directory list, not an election report: the directory prints the council's membership as it stood when the edition was compiled (late in the year after the election). It does not say how members were returned and cannot show co-options made between the election and compilation. There was no contest in the district in 1949 (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949, p. 7), so the member was returned unopposed.
